notes: From the right: the first song smaller than its right neighbour, swapped with the rightmost bigger song, then the tail reversed; with no such song the whole list is reversed. Strict comparisons in the wrong places stall on equal numbers; skipping the reversal leaves the last order in place.

traps: the last order wraps round to the first
only the last two songs change
the first song changes and the whole tail turns

rejects.name: treats equal numbers as a step up
leaves the last order as it is
